newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Menem rules out devaluation.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Menem rules out devaluation.

text.p: Argentina's President Carlos Menem ruled out Wednesday any possible devaluation of the peso under his government.
"There is no possibility of a devaluation of our currency, at least while I am president," Menem told local television.
"There exists a current of opinion which is producing uncertainty in the community. That is why I want to deny this sort of rumor," he said.

Argentina's peso has been pegged at par to the dollar since 1991. But stubbornly high unemployment and slow growth have fomented an increasingly rebellious spirit within the ranks of the governing Peronist Party and contributed to unease over the future of the economic plan.
